<thought>Search the template catalog for any template that forms a primary amine (the product of nitro reduction). Use nitrobenzene as the target molecule and specify only the functional group formed as primary amines, leaving other criteria empty.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc1",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
